record.what_it_does: Mailchimp's Marketing API lets developers manage audiences/contacts, campaigns, automations, templates, reports, and e-commerce data programmatically to power email/SMS marketing.
record.auth_notes: API keys and OAuth2 access tokens are used interchangeably via HTTP Basic or Bearer auth against the same endpoints. Mailchimp explicitly recommends OAuth2 for apps acting on behalf of other users' accounts, and API key for single-account/tightly-coupled use. Mailchimp OAuth2 access tokens do not expire and there is no refresh_token flow. A separate product, Mailchimp Transactional (Mandrill), has its own API/key and is distinct from the Marketing API.
record.access_notes: Signing up for a free Mailchimp account (free for under 250 contacts) gives immediate access to the API Keys page to generate a working key; the Quick Start guide confirms API key generation requires no paid plan, though some advanced endpoints/features are gated by plan tier.
